rationale: Host-loading hardening only: .pulpgraph plugin nodes resolve against known plugin roots with scanning off by default, CLAP scanning runs in the isolated worker with no in-process fallback, and the worker protects its descriptor protocol from plugin stdout. The family is touched through docs/reference/cli.md and docs/status/cli-commands.yaml edits for the pulp scan --in-process flag and the removed bake flag; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
